capabilities: Sync the .obsidian configuration folder to a WebDAV server
Exclude individual plugins and device-local state files from syncing
Merge text config conflicts with diff3 three-way merge or keep-both/local-win/remote-win strategies
Test network connectivity before syncing and report the failure cause
Run syncs manually, on events, or on a timed interval
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installed manually by copying main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css into the plugins folder. Bilingual English/Chinese documentation. If a content-sync plugin runs alongside, .obsidian must be added to its excluded folders.
intentEvidence: WebDAV client layer is forked from nextcloud-sync-yanc (MIT), with Nextcloud-only features (version history, file locking, chunked upload, sync tokens) removed
problem: Content sync plugins handle notes but exclude or mishandle the configuration folder, so settings, themes, and plugin lists don't transfer between devices.

relations.evidence: The WebDAV client layer is forked from nextcloud-sync-yanc (MIT)
Other WebDAV servers (Nextcloud, self-hosted, etc.) work too.
Jianguoyun (坚果云) WebDAV address is pre-filled — you only supply an account and an App Password.

requires.name: a WebDAV server account (Jianguoyun, Nextcloud, or self-hosted)

summary: WebDAV plugin that syncs only the vault's .obsidian configuration folder, independently of notes-content sync, with diff3 conflict merging.
